summary: Fees were addressed by both sides in the first negotiation round and before the class relief was settled. Hargrove’s private reasoning considered its own fee economics when choosing a counter, but the transcript does not clearly show it sacrificed class recovery for higher firm compensation. Defense accepted the lowest pending deal among competing class counsel to secure a release of overlapping claims, supporting a reverse-auction-tactics label.
